constructs.name: pOpen-TetO-deGFP
findings: The full sequence is inline in main.md, carried from the source Doc. No .gb or .gbk file matching it was found, so devstudio-verify-dna-constructs was not run.

Landmarks measured against the inline sequence on 2026-10-11: T7 promoter at base 5, tetO operator at base 26, g10 leader and RBS at base 90, deGFP CDS 104 to 781 (678 nt, 225 codons), T7 terminator at base 791.

RULED OUT: nucleus-eng/DNA detectors/pOpen-pT7-tetO.gb. 2954 bp, CDS 1705..2397 is plamGFP (693 nt, 230 aa, MEIEDVIKRDMK), against the Doc's deGFP (678 nt, 225 aa, MELFTGVVPILV). 7.6% residue identity. It also uses UTR1 and a T7hyb6 terminator.

CLOSEST MATCH: nucleus-eng/DNA reporters/pOpen-deGFP.gbk. 2812 bp, 43 bp shorter. 22 of 23 sampled 120-nt windows of the Doc appear in it verbatim; the one that does not is bases 1-120, holding the promoter, operator and RBS. It has the T7 promoter and deGFP CDS but no tetO.
REVIEW: build the GenBank file from reporters/pOpen-deGFP.gbk plus the 43 bp tetO insertion, or supply the authoritative file, and add it to dna/.
